closure_evidence: This evidence commit is the direct child of ending_implementation_commit.
objective: Expose one bounded latest completed governed Browser PTT result as presentation-only resident state without adding execution authority.

accepted_contract.source: One already-completed submitted TurnResult from the existing Browser PTT coordinator path.
accepted_contract.retention: One replacement value in resident process memory; retained by Restart GRACI and discarded on process exit.
accepted_contract.delivery: Snapshot schema v2 is authoritative; polling, refresh, SSE reconnect, latest_turn_updated, and additional tabs converge on it.

required: Complete one physical Browser PTT governed PASS and verify the same response after refresh and in a second tab.
Complete or observe one governed failure and verify no fabricated response text is shown.
Use explicit PTT barge-in and verify governed success remains distinct from cancelled speech presentation.
Use Restart GRACI and verify the latest completed result remains while transient task and voice state clear.
Stop and start the resident and verify latest-turn state begins empty without reading runs/.

explicit_exclusions: wake word, VAD, always listening, or autonomous conversation
automatic follow-up, retry, approval, or speculative execution
memory, routing, validation, model, node, 3090, 4090, or MO2 policy changes
